title: Thị trường nông sản thế giới / World Agricultural Markets

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic functions and characteristics of the global agricultural market, international commitments in agricultural trade under economic globalization, and the overall picture of supply, demand, prices, and trends in the global market for major agricultural products such as rice, seafood, forestry products, fruits and vegetables, and some industrial crops like coffee, tea, pepper, and rubber.

Analyze and synthesize information on global market trends for specific agricultural products, identify opportunities and challenges for Vietnam in international trade, and propose solutions for developing production and export of these products.
Effectively communicate with peers and stakeholders, present information on global markets for specific agricultural products, and manage time and resources efficiently.
Understand and analyze national policies and regulations related to international trade in agricultural products, and propose policy recommendations for managing and promoting international trade.
Develop critical thinking skills to identify opportunities and challenges in global agricultural markets, and propose solutions for sustainable development.
Understand and comply with national laws and regulations, and respect ethical and professional responsibilities.
Develop the ability to self-learn and accumulate knowledge and experience to continue higher education and adapt to changing work environments.
